text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, gearing up for the open campus concert,
Fenomeno was practicing together
with the other Umamusume who would be dancing with her—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hup, ngh... Ah!?
choice_data_list: So close! You were doing so well up to that point!
So close! You were doing so well up to that point, you know!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to nervousness, my body won't move...!
Urgh... at this rate, I will ruin the quality of the live performance...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Um... everyone!
If it's alright, could you please give me some advice!?
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask as well. Please, lend me your strength
A favor from me too. Please, lend us your strength.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Smiles are crucial for a performance!
How about we practice smiling?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: We should look for a fundamental solution.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Your problem is, yes... your heart.
Dance with me seriously, and find your answer."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't we play to Fenomeno-san's strengths?
Let's solidify her fundamentals and build up her confidence.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush, so don't worry.
Though it may seem like a detour, it is often the quickest path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All three of them have completely different types of advice.
It's probably best to ask just one of them—
choice_data_list: Let's have Hokko Tarumae teach us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All three of them have completely different types of advice.
It's probably best to ask just one of them—
choice_data_list: Let's have Hokko Tarumae teach us!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! To get a wonderful smile... first, let's look back on the fun things that have happened!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If it were me... it'd be having fresh surf clams back home!
Packed with nutrients, with a rich, ocean-raised flavor—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Nfufufu~. Pure bliss~~.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-What a dazzling smile...!
I see! Then, in my case—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
While volunteering to watch over kids walking to school.
Seeing the children energetically cross the crosswalk...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheerful voices echo around.
Seeing such a peaceful scene, I couldn't help but raise my voice too—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haaave a safe triiiip!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...That's right! And because of that, the kids got scared, and some of them started crying~~...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Cut, cut, cut that out~~!
I only want to remember the fun parts!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
See? Everyone was able to go to school
with peace of mind thanks to Fenomeno-san, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... That's right...!
I was seeing off her joyful back—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Take care, and have a safe trip!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, keep that smile! All right, one-two, one-two!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This feels... light!
My body feels so light, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I can do it...! Thank you so much, Tarumae-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the day of the open campus.
Fenomeno and the others' concert begins!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The children's smiling faces... their cheerful voices—
Alright, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, one-two, one-two!
Hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
All right, time for my—Locodol Smile~♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Fuhahahahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With gentle movements and expressions,
Fenomeno led the live performance to tremendous success!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
All righty~~!
Safety first! One-two! One-two!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait, there are no lyrics like that!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone together♪
Cars can't stop on a dime! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the concert, Fenomeno wore a beaming smile
and moved fluidly, but...
she ended up getting the lyrics wrong in a few places.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll be your partner.
Show me—your full-force dance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Ugh!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The air around Gentil-san changed!
What incredible pressure...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh...! I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"So you can still move.
Then... how about this?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "The pressure is building even more...! At this rate—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to lose... No, had I already lost?
My heart had already accepted defeat...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Without even realizing it myself,
was I already broken... even before I started dancing...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheh.
No wonder you couldn't dance like this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...And?
Are you planning to step down from the stage?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...No, the real battle starts now!
I won't fall behind!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ooooaaaarrrrgghhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. ...Did I awaken a lion, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the day of the open campus.
Fenomeno and the others' concert begins!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let us show all our visitors...
our dancing at its absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAGHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
How stifling.
However, I do not dislike it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I will wiiiiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a tremendously powerful dance,
Fenomeno brought immense energy to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I won't lose to you!
Never! No matter what!!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing?
This is the center. Return to your position.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'M! THE! CEN! TER!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno got a little too serious
and ended up dancing wildly out of control...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let us start from the very basics, then.
Please focus your awareness all the way through to your fingertips as you dance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Um... is this acceptable, sir?
We have been repeating the exact same thing for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My body's still moving so stiffly...!
At this rate, I'll be totally frozen up for the real thing—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Stop! Don't move!
That pose right now looks amazing on you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It seems to have become second nature through repetition...
Such sharp, crisp movements!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: True, your movements were stiff, but there was a resolute, razor-sharp edge to them. That is your unique strength... your weapon!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I-I see...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind dancing while looking at yourself in the mirror?
I'm sure you look very fierce and powerful.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Ohh! Sharp, and so dignified!
Every single movement is flawless!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna master this straightforward, pure dance style, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... Fenomeno-san,
your fundamentals have solidified, you're looking like a whole new runner.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes! Pick me, pick meee!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Giggle... Please don't push yourself too hard.
We still have lessons left, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me!
I'll see it through to the end, in my own way!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the day of the open campus.
Fenomeno and the others' concert begins!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Alright! Time to nail this with perfection, sir!

text_block_list.name: Observing Child
text_block_list.text:
That big sis is so cool...!
Her movements are so sharp!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is watching you, Fenomeno-san.
Ufufufu.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, that really got me-de arimasu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the live performance, Fenomeno captivated the spectators
with her sharp moves and piercing gaze!
